title: Trading on mean-reversion in energy futures markets
summary: Spread-rule paper is not an owned outright-futures candidate. Dataset metadata is not acquired/admitted data.
about: Technical mean-reversion rules applied to energy hedge portfolios.
findings: The inspected publisher text identifies calendar spreads, not outright front-contract CL/NG trades.
mechanism: Relative-value convergence is proposed; outright price timing is not the source payoff.
build_on: No current TEST: paired dated contracts and source-matched construction are not admitted; routine indicator/spread work is outside the current priority.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Only after faithful spread legs and complete source rules; no outright substitution.
reading_scope: Indexed publisher metadata/introduction and public dataset listing only.
source_version: Thorben Lubnau and Neda Todorova; Energy Economics51,312–319,2015.
owned_input_mapping: Requires dated spread legs. https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/59nt46nnb4/1 was indexed, not downloaded or coverage-validated.
deeper_investigation: Move on; no unsupported claim that the advertised data are inherently paid or inaccessible.
